Artikkeli omalla kuvalla

The first paragraph opens the story. The harbour authority announced on Monday that the old ferry terminal will be torn down next spring, and that a new terminal with room for two ships at once will be built in its place.

The second paragraph adds the detail. The new terminal will cost about forty million euros, of which the state pays a third, and the work is expected to take two summers because the harbour must stay open during the building.
